bullets.text: In Sengundram, Thiruvallur district, a school van driver was arrested under the POCSO Act for allegedly sexually harassing a five-year-old girl, while initial police inaction should be monitored.
Chennai experienced sudden heavy rain causing waterlogging, and the meteorological department warns of heavy rain across eight districts tomorrow on Diwali.
A couple visiting Besant Nagar at 2 AM to watch the sunrise faced unexpected trouble.
Southern Railway is awaiting RDSO clearance to rectify the platform gap at the newly constructed Adambakkam station.
The Home Secretary transferred four police officers, appointing Hari Kiran Prasad as Ramanathapuram SP and Eswaran as Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner.
In Thiruvallur, a man attempting to attack an SI injured his own hand after tripping and falling.
Thirty-one sovereigns of gold jewellery were stolen from a teacher's house near Chennai in Thiruvallur district.
Heavy traffic congestion was reported on the Poonamallee Mount Road ahead of Diwali.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay ordered a Rs 2,000-crore allocation to implement the Vetri Laptop Scheme for college students.
Vultr launched a 20-megawatt AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by over 10,000 AMD GPUs.
The University of Madras syndicate approved an MoU with Sutherland Global Services to establish an AI lab.
The Periyar Arivulagam book procurement controversy led the Tamil Nadu government to form a panel to inspect libraries amid blame-shifting between TVK and the previous DMK regime.
